column1: # Key of the Jablonski-Ráday numeric syllabary, 1705-1707 (cyphersolver leads 2169 + 2170), rebuilt by Brice Dudout
# (Claude Opus 5.5 agents), 10 Nov 2026, from the enciphering drafts of Daniel Ernst Jablonski to Pál Ráday,
# Staatsbibliothek zu Berlin - PK, Nachl. A. H. Francke 11,2/15 nos 8, 13, 33 (1705) and 11,2/16 no 42 (1706).
# Licence: CC BY 4.0, Brice Dudout (the table as rebuilt here; the drafts it comes from carry their own Latin plaintext).
# One-part, alphabetically ordered numeric syllabary: single letters with homophones (30-70 and round numbers 110-300),
# syllables in alphabetical order (84 ab ... 223 ut), code words 225-241, nulls below 30 and 301-310, 390, 401.
# Learned from 350 figure/plaintext pairs (1,368 groups, pairs.tsv), frozen as frozen/03_KEY.json (SHA-256 04901dec...04ef),
# then measured ONCE on the held-out draft 11,2/16 no 44 (validation.txt): 0.930 of characters vs 0.247 for the best
# of 200 shuffled keys. "probable" = seen once in the pairs. 171 and 278 are unresolved and not in the table.
# This file = the working table CLE-jablonski-raday-1705-1707.tsv (SHA-256 20a513b0...2d55) with these header lines added.
# Jablonski-Raday syllabary, 1705-1707 (rebuilt from SBB Nachl. Francke 11,2/15 nos 8,13,33 and 11,2/16 no 42). value "" = null.
